description: DRAFT: may change until published. A release (album, EP, single...) posted by a band's own account. Ingested releases (RSS, MusicBrainz) are NOT records: they live in TBA's index, labeled as ingested.

releaseDate.description: Release day as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD: a calendar date, not an instant (no time, no timezone). Partial dates cover announcements like 'new album 2027'. May be in the future. Lexicons can't express the pattern; writers and the indexer must check it with parseReleaseDate().

links.description: Where to listen/buy. TBA links out; it doesn't host audio.

otherArtists.description: For splits and collaborations: the other bands, claimed or not (the posting account is always an artist on the release).

externalIds.description: The release's ids in other catalogues (e.g. a MusicBrainz release group), used to deduplicate against ingested releases.
